app.name: Author
app.title: Documentation Author
app.slogan: Create exciting educational content using Electra Academy.
app.description:
With Documentation Author, you can easily create and share documents, worksheets, and course materials online. You can add circuits, math formulas, cloze, pictures, and more to your documents, making them more engaging and informative. Sharing your work with others has never been easier.

I hope you'll give it a try!

empty.description: Start by adding your first content to make it feel more alive in here!

image.dragdrop: Drag & Drop image or click to upload

dialog.promote_explain: Make your version the one your group uses? Everyone who gets this document from your group will then see your changes.
dialog.promote_description_label: Note for the reviewers (optional) - what changed and why?
dialog.revert_explain: Throw away your changes and show the group's version again? This can't be undone.
dialog.delete_explain: Delete this document? There's no group version to fall back to, so this can't be undone.
dialog.delete_shared_explain: Delete this document for the whole group? It disappears for everyone here, and this can't be undone.
dialog.delete_shared_request_explain: Ask to delete this document? Your group's reviewers have to approve it before it's removed for everyone.
dialog.open_conflict_explain: You have a personal copy of this document. Open your own copy, or the group's version?
dialog.distribute_explain: Send your version to other workspaces you're in. If a workspace uses review, it's checked there first. Otherwise everyone in that workspace (and the ones under it) sees it right away.
dialog.distribute_empty: You are not a member of any other workspace to distribute to yet.

activity.title: Activity
activity.intro: What's happening across your workspaces: how your drafts turned out, reviews waiting for you, and your own actions.

event.delete_requested: {{actor}} asks you to review the deletion of {{subject}} in {{scope}}
event.i_withdrew: You withdrew the request for {{subject}} in {{scope}}

review.title: Review
review.intro: Documents waiting for your approval. Your vote is worth the review points your workspace admin gave you. Once enough points add up, the document goes live. A single reject stops it.
review.deletion_notice: This document is up for deletion. Approving removes it for everyone here.
review.my_points_hint: Your vote adds this many points
review.withdraw_explain: Withdraw this request? It will be removed as if you never submitted it.
review.not_open: This review is no longer open
review.load_failed: Could not load the review document
review.no_change_comment: No note - the author didn't say what changed.
review.reject_explain: Rejecting closes this request right away. The author has to make changes and submit it again.
review.accept_explain: As an admin, you can approve this right now and skip the usual review. Continue?
review.instruction_reviewer: The author is asking for your approval. Once enough people accept it, it goes live for everyone in the workspace.
review.instruction_admin: As an admin of this workspace, you can accept it immediately.
review.instruction_voted: Thanks, you've already approved this. Once enough people do, it goes live.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.intro: A workspace makes sure everyone sees exactly the documents meant for them. You decide who belongs, and everything you share there stays with exactly those people. A workspace can contain more workspaces, from a small group up to a whole organization: the higher up you post a document, the more people you reach. Open one to explore, or create your own and invite others.
workspaces.create_needs_parent: Open a workspace first, then create a sub-workspace inside it.
workspaces.required_score_hint: How many approval points a document needs before it goes live here. 0 = no review.

draft.title: My Files
draft.intro: Your own documents live here: your private ones, and your copy of any shared document you've changed. Only you can see them. Want to share your version? Promote it to make it your group's version, or Distribute it to other workspaces you're in. If a workspace uses review, your version is checked there before it goes live.
draft.review_points_explain: {{have}} of {{need}} approval points so far. Once it reaches {{need}}, your version goes live for the group.
draft.kind_personal_explain: This document lives only in your personal space. Nobody else can see it.
draft.kind_personal_copy_explain: This is your own copy of a shared document. Promote it to send your changes for review. Once approved, they become your group's version.

files.title: Shared Files
files.intro: All the documents your groups share with you. Open one to use it. When you edit and save, you get your own copy (in My Files) and the original stays untouched.

message.contains_learning: This page contains learning material which ends later in two documents: a worksheet and a solution paper.
message.distributed: Sent to {{total}} workspace(s) - {{live}} live, {{review}} in review.
